text_block_list.text: Hmm... Hmmm... Ohh, what should I do?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hey, who's that? Do they need help? I'm
gonna go see if I can lend a
hand!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Kitasan?
...Dang, she's pretty light on
her feet.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. That's Kita for you. Ever since we
were young, she's never been
able to turn
away from someone in trouble.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Since you were young? Oh, so you guys
are childhood friends, huh? In
that case,
you're both sure to grow by leaps and
bounds.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hm? Uh, thank you...

Ahhh, the pork cutlet curry has way too
many calories... But I just can't
resist that
crispy, fluffy goodness...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If you want to eat it so badly, why hold
back? The extra calories will
give you
more energy for training!

That's a great point!
I think I'll go with the
curry so I can work even
harder!

I always have trouble making up my mind,
so I appreciate the push!
Umm...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I'm Kitasan Black! I'm new here to the
academy!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm Matikanetannhauser! Thanks again,
Kita!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku and Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Tanny-in-the-Hauserrr!
Machitaaaan!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wahhh! You scared me!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whatcha got there? Pork cutlet curry?
Hmm... The brown vibe works, but how
'bout adding a tomato salad for a
splash of
color?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, tomato! Yeah, making it more colorful
would definitely up the
flavor!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Check this! I'm gonna add even more colors! Ketchup! Mayo! Mustard! Fish eggs! ...Grapes!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh, uh-huh... Huh?! That sounds gross!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Don't hate—let her cook! Why not go all in
and make it an
Umasta-worthy rainbow
curry?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Rainbow curry?!
C-careful not to overdo it,
now...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Kita... There's something almost
soothing about that Tannhauser
girl, don't
you think?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking the same thing! Guess
there are people like her
here at Tracen
Academy too.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Btdubs, now that Tannhauser's here, how about we kick off the grand finale? I was hoping you could do me a solid, Turbo... Mutter, mutter, mutter...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, yeah! That sounds awesome! Gimme
a sec to get set up, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I've got a bad feeling about this...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yo, yo! What's up guuuys! ☆ Who's ready
to P-A-R-T-Y? B-b-boom!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Yeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wh-what the heck is this?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It appears to be a DJ kit. When did they
set it up?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Make some noise for Kita and Sato! DJ
Helios here, ready to turn up
and lay down
some sick beats! Hit it, Turbo! ☆

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Aye aye, sir! Time to start the music!
Clickety-poke!
BOOM! ♪ BOOM! ♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaagh! Yo, Turbo! That's way too
loud! I know I said to "turn up,"
but still...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Urgh...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: She's down?! S-somebody stop the music!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: That's easier said than done!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We'll burst our eardrums if we get any
closer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
This is bad! If we don't do something
quick, you-know-who is gonna
notice...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Eek! Palmer, look behind you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Oh.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Okay, it's way cleaner now! Let's take a
break, everyone! Nice work!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You know it! We make one heck of a team!
Wanna form a squad? We
can be "The
Super Trash Troopers ☆" or something!
Woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Considering we'll be participating in a
wide range of student council-organized
activities,
I think a more appropriate name would
be "The Community Service Squad ☆."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan, Satono—sorry for getting you
guys mixed up in all this. But I
gotta say,
I'm impressed. You two've got some skills.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You think so? Well, I guess we're used to
it. I used to do volunteer
work like this all
the time with Dia's family!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah? Your family has a passion for
that kind of thing, Satono?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I actually first met Kita while
volunteering. It feels so long ago
now. By
the way, will you all be okay? Don't you
have races?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but they've organized our schedule
to keep this community
service from
interfering with our training, so we'll
manage. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Satono
text_block_list.text: So carefree...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume's Journal
text_block_list.text:
"My to-do list keeps growing day by day.
But it's a lot of fun. From now on, I'm
going to get up early and go running every
morning!
...Unless I snooze too long."
